Installation Tips

  • Choose the installation location, attach the small wooden block to the back of the vase to mark the approximate position, and mark the first hole on the wall through the small wooden block.
  • Use a 6mm drill bit (to be purchased by the customer) to drill a hole about 30mm deep at the marked point on the wall.
  • Insert the small yellow plug into the hole from the previous step.
  • Tighten the small wooden block with screws until it is neither loose nor too tight.
  • Hang the vase, adjust it to your desired angle, and then remove the vase.
  • Mark the third hole on the wall through the small wooden block.
  • Drill a 30mm deep hole in the marked wall, insert the small yellow plug, and fix the small wooden block on the wall.
  • Hang the vase and enjoy the fun of flower arrangement!

  • Adjustable Stand Options:
    1. Φ7.5 Model:
      • Height adjustable: 13.5 cm – 24 cm (5.31 – 9.45 in)
      • Distance between the ring and the pole is also adjustable
    2. Φ7.0 Model:
      • Only height adjustable: 15 cm – 22.5 cm (5.91 – 8.86 in)

70mm vs 75mm Version

70mm Version (Precision Fit / Stable Setup)

  • Optimized specifically for standard V60 filters
  • Tighter fit for enhanced stability during brewing
  • More compact footprint, ideal for small coffee stations
  • Reduces movement for a more controlled pour-over experience

Best for: daily V60 users / minimal setups / stable brewing focus

75mm Version (Flexible Compatibility / Adjustable Use)

  • Wider compatibility beyond standard V60 filters
  • Adjustable holder spacing for different dripper sizes
  • Better suited for experimenting with various brewing tools
  • Ideal for multi-brewer coffee setups

Best for: coffee enthusiasts who enjoy experimenting / multi-tool setups

How to Choose

  • Limited counter space → 70mm version
  • Want maximum stability for V60 → 70mm version
  • Want flexibility for different brewers → 75mm version
  • Enjoy experimenting with coffee styles → 75mm version
